description: MongoDB's Generative AI Showcase: an exhaustive collection of examples and sample applications covering Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and industry-specific use cases.

summary.one_liner: A collection of MongoDB-focused generative AI examples, notebooks, sample apps, and workshops covering RAG, AI agents, and industry use cases.
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a curated collection of GenAI examples built around MongoDB, organized into four folders: notebooks (Jupyter examples for RAG, agentic applications, and evaluations), apps (JavaScript and Python demos), workshops (self-paced hands-on material), and partners (contributions from MongoDB's AI partners). The README shows how MongoDB is used in RAG pipelines and AI agents as a vector database, operational database, and memory provider. Running any example requires a MongoDB cluster, and the README suggests a free MongoDB Atlas account. The README itself is a short index; it does not describe individual examples in detail.
use_cases: build ai agents with mongodb as memory
use mongodb as a vector database for llm apps
prototype rag pipelines in jupyter notebooks
how_to_run: Register for a free MongoDB Atlas account
Obtain the connection string for your database cluster
Browse the notebooks, apps, or workshops folder and follow the instructions in the example you choose
notable: Covers RAG, AI agents, and industry-specific use cases in one repo
Shows MongoDB as vector database, operational database, and memory provider
Split into notebooks, apps, workshops, and partner contributions
Includes evaluation examples alongside RAG and agent code
caveats: Every example needs a connection to a MongoDB cluster, so a MongoDB Atlas account is effectively required
The README is a high-level index and does not document individual examples or their dependencies
